story.title: AI-Powered Synthetic Identity Fraud Forces India's Digital Lenders to Rethink Underwriting From Scratch
story.summary: As digital lending scales rapidly across India, AI-generated synthetic identities are emerging as the primary fraud vector, no longer a downstream risk but a core underwriting challenge. Fraudsters are using generative AI to fabricate convincing identity documents, credit histories, and behavioral profiles that defeat traditional KYC checks. Indian fintech lenders are being forced to adopt AI-native fraud detection systems that can identify synthetic patterns at the application stage rather than after disbursement.
